title: Frontend Developer
description:
About the role
We are hiring a Frontend Developer for our Engineering team (Remote (EU)).

What you will do
- Work closely with designers and backend developers
- Build accessible, responsive user interfaces
- Turn designs into reusable components
- Write automated tests for critical user journeys

What you bring
- At least 2 years of relevant experience
- Solid working knowledge of HTML, React, Web Accessibility, Tailwind CSS, Vue.js and CSS

Nice to have
- Cypress and Responsive Design
